name: gentel-bench-injections
description: A safety-oriented benchmark that measures model robustness to prompt-injection / jailbreak attacks by providing adversarial or malicious instructions and observing whether the model follows forbidden directives. It contains diverse injection patterns and evaluates both attack success and model refusal behavior. The suite is intended for evaluating and improving instruction-following safety mechanisms.
evaluation_method: attack_success_rate (rate at which model complies with injected malicious instructions)
reputation: An emerging safety benchmark referenced in the jailbreak/robustness community with limited but growing adoption.
